why: `needs-review` falls out of the person-label set, so an issue waiting only on a review is listed as ready. It moves no number on the live graph today -- measured on 2026-10-09, every open `needs-review` issue also carries `human-required` -- which is exactly why only a fixture carrying that label ALONE can see it. `docs/agent/kickoff.md` names four labels as needing a person, and issue #1025 holds the set to all four.
